summary: PulseGuard v0.6.29 hardens the automatic updater so deleted or rolled-back GitHub releases cannot remain falsely advertised as installable updates, while retaining the v0.6.28 runtime self-repair and all v0.6.27 diagnostic/repair fixes.

sections.heading: Updater now validates the actual GitHub release before showing Update Found
sections.detail: When latest.json advertises a newer version, PulseGuard now verifies that the matching GitHub release tag and exact ZIP asset are currently published before displaying an available-update state or downloading anything.

sections.heading: Deleted/rolled-back releases are ignored safely
sections.detail: If latest.json still references a release that has been deleted, has no matching ZIP asset, or disagrees with the published asset size/URL, PulseGuard treats that manifest as orphaned/inconsistent, stays on the installed version, and does not show a false installable update.

sections.heading: Manifest version, tag and asset name must agree
sections.detail: The package URL must now exactly match the manifest version using releases/download/vX.Y.Z/PulseGuard_PC_vX.Y.Z.zip. A manifest cannot advertise one version while pointing at a different tag or asset name.

sections.heading: Release validation has a safe network fallback
sections.detail: PulseGuard first checks the GitHub release API. If that validation path is temporarily unavailable, it falls back to a direct HEAD check of the exact release asset without installing or modifying program files.

sections.heading: Incomplete-install recovery retained
sections.detail: All v0.6.28 protections remain: missing Data/Logs/Reports/Backups folders are recreated, critical missing runtime/config files can be restored from protected bundled recovery copies, and incomplete releases are rejected before installation.

sections.heading: Repair and diagnostics retained
sections.detail: All v0.6.27 fixes remain included, including forced SFC repair when corruption is proven, PCIe WHEA Event 17 diagnostics/history handling, unattended restart-aware WinGet, protected system PATH handling, Deep Clean reporting, exact driver-update auditing, and guarded sppsvc repair behavior.
